alternatives.option: Keep transcript grepping with better regexes
alternatives.reason_rejected: Prose mentioning tool names still counts as calls; transcript format drift breaks it silently — the same bug class recurs.

context: 6 of 9 externally-filed issues were hook-layer failures; the pre-commit hook had already abandoned transcript grepping (#11/#13) but the Stop hook still used it and fired in non-twining repos.
rationale: The Stop hook now compares .twining/.last-record against the newest dirty-file mtime; when no sentinel exists the record tools are unreachable, so blocking would be unsatisfiable — a coordination tool must never be the reason a commit is impossible.
summary: All hook gates are sentinel-based and fail open when unsatisfiable — no transcript grepping anywhere, and a fresh clone or dead server never blocks commits or session exit
